title: 10x Genomics Library Construction
author: Graham J Etherington
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd3vi8n6
materials: Input DNA (in this case Polecat) was diluted down from 4.18 ng/ul to 1 ng/ul using Qiagen EB and checked using a QuBit 2.0 Fluorometer (Thermo-Fisher). The sample was then diluted in half as it was denatured. Finally, 2.5 µL of the diluted and denatured DNA was loaded onto the 10X chip which equated to 1.25 ng .

The formed emulsion was removed and placed into the thermocycler for 03:00:00 at 30 °C . GEMs were cleaned up using the recovery reagent (10X Genomics), Silane beads (Thermo Fisher) and Tween-20 (Sigma-Aldrich) as per manufacturer’s instructions. DNA is cleaned up using a 0.7X ratio of SPRISelect beads (Beckman Coulter).

The library underwent simultaneous End Repair and A tailing on the thermocycler at 20 °C for 00:30:00 and then 65 °C for 00:30:00 . Adapters were then ligated at 20 °C for 00:15:00 . A 0.8X ratio SPRISelect clean-up was performed. Sample Indexes were added during the final 8 cycle PCR amplification. steps.title: Load reagents onto 10X chip
steps.instruction: Load gel beads, oil, and master mix into the appropriate wells of the 10X Chromium chip, then add the DNA together with the master mix, and place the loaded chip into the 10X Genomics Chromium instrument.

substeps.instruction: Dispense gel beads, oil, and master mix into designated wells of the chip.
Add the DNA sample together with the master mix to the chip.
Insert the completed chip into the Chromium instrument.

steps.title: Perform dual‑SPRI size selection
steps.instruction: Carry out a two‑step SPRI bead size selection on the library, first at a 0.5× bead‑to‑sample ratio, then at a 0.7× ratio.

steps.title: Assess library size and molarity
steps.instruction: Measure library fragment size using an Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Bioanalyzer and determine library molarity by qPCR with the KAPA Library Quant kit (Illumina) using ABI Prism qPCR Mix (Kapa Biosystems).

substeps.instruction: Run the library on the High Sensitivity DNA Bioanalyzer to obtain size distribution.
Set up qPCR reactions with the KAPA Library Quant kit and ABI Prism qPCR Mix to calculate molarity.

steps.title: Cluster library and sequence on Illumina
steps.instruction: Cluster the library on an Illumina flow cell at 8 pM with 1 % PhiX spike‑in, load two lanes of a Rapid Run v2 flow cell on a HiSeq2500, and run a 150 bp paired‑end read with an 8 bp i7 index read (no i5 index), achieving ~1,100 K clusters /mm².

substeps.instruction: Prepare the library at 8 pM concentration and add 1 % PhiX spike‑in.
Load the prepared library onto a Rapid Run v2 flow cell (two lanes) in the HiSeq2500.
Run the sequencing: 150 bp paired‑end reads, 8 bp i7 index read, 0 bp i5 index read.
Confirm clustering density of approximately 1,100 K clusters per mm².
